scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w worker && npm run test -w api
